theorems.statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (M W : Set (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P) (v₀ : Euclid d), IsOpen V → IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ V → InjOn ψ V → ψ '' V = W ∩ M → (∀ K ⊆ W, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) → (∀ z ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ z)) → v₀ ∈ V → ∃ (O : Set (Euclid P)) (ρ : Euclid P → Euclid d), IsOpen O ∧ ψ v₀ ∈ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ρ O ∧ MapsTo ρ O V ∧ ∀ z ∈ M ∩ O, ψ (ρ z) = z
